company_name: One Hour Air Conditioning & Heating of Scottsdale
parent_or_brand: One Hour Heating & Air Conditioning (Authority Brands franchise system)
source: Authority Brands official 'Our Brands' page and Franchise Times Top 400 2025 listing confirm One Hour Heating & Air Conditioning is a franchised network under Authority Brands (itself PE-backed by American Securities); individual locations including Scottsdale operate as independently owned/operated franchisees, not corporate stores. Could not confirm the specific local franchisee's name with certainty.

parent_or_brand: Roto-Rooter Services Company / Chemed Corporation (NYSE: CHE)
source: Roto-Rooter is a wholly owned subsidiary of publicly traded Chemed Corporation. Roto-Rooter Services Co. acquired Hoffman Southwest Corp's independent franchise operations covering Phoenix, Tucson, and Florence, AZ in 2019, converting AZ Roto-Rooter territories from franchised to company-owned branches (PRNewswire/Franchising.com/Trenchless Technology, Sept 2019).

parent_or_brand: All Aloha Plumbing (common founder network with San Diego CA and Hawaii sister locations; not a licensed franchise)
source: All Aloha Plumbing Phoenix and San Diego 'About Us' pages plus BBB profiles show the Phoenix location is a sister company under common owner Deven Tells, who founded the brand in Hawaii before expanding to San Diego and Phoenix. Not PE-backed or corporately structured as a franchise. Note: ROC license was flagged inactive in the source data - operating status should be re-verified.

source: Same corporate structure as other AZ Roto-Rooter entries (subsidiary of publicly traded Chemed Corp). The 2019 Hoffman Southwest acquisition article explicitly names Phoenix/Tucson/Florence as converted to company-owned; Yuma is not explicitly named so this is inferred rather than directly confirmed.

parent_or_brand: Techcool (same company as Techcool Cooling & Heating, HQ North Las Vegas, NV - multi-state operation, not a separate franchise)
source: techcoollv.com serves the Scottsdale/Arizona pages from the same domain and company as the North Las Vegas HQ; BBB and Yelp profiles describe Techcool as a family-owned and operated business (~20 years). The ZI 'match' is the same underlying company operating across state lines, not an unrelated franchise brand.

source: Same corporate structure as other AZ Roto-Rooter entries (subsidiary of publicly traded Chemed Corp). Cornville, AZ is a small town in the broader north-central AZ market likely serviced under the same company-owned AZ territory network established after the 2019 Hoffman Southwest acquisition, though not explicitly named in that coverage.

PRNewswire 'Bow River Capital Completes Sale of Veregy' (Nov 3, 2020) confirms Court Square Capital Partners acquired Veregy (an energy efficiency/ESCO platform built from AZ-based Midstate Energy and other roll-up acquisitions) from Bow River Capital; PitchBook and Mergr corroborate Court Square as current PE owner.

dpelectric.com About page: company became 100% employee-owned (ESOP) in 2024 (up from 30% in 2021); founder Dan Puente (started 1990) remains Chairman of the Board and his daughter Danielle Puente Torres became President/CEO in 2023. No external PE or corporate parent found.

parent_or_brand: Wilson Electric Services Corp (employee-owned ESOP parent; Netsian Technologies Group operates as a dba/subsidiary)
source: Constrafor contractor directory lists 'Wilson Electric Services Corp dba Netsian Technologies Group'; Wilson Electric Services Corp (Tempe, AZ) has been employee-owned (ESOP) since 2005 per its own company brochure - not PE-backed. Note: the 'Beecroft' prefix in this record's company name is unexplained (possibly a data merge artifact) and was not corroborated by any source found.

parent_or_brand: Apex Service Partners (Alpine Investors portfolio company)
source: PitchBook company profile states ACE Home Services was acquired May 9, 2022 by Apex Service Partners, which is itself an Alpine Investors home-services roll-up platform active in the Arizona/Sun Belt HVAC-plumbing-electrical market.

Parker & Sons 'About Us' page (operating as Environmental Conditioning, LLC dba Parker & Sons) and an industry podcast (rynoss.com, 'The $210M Parker & Sons Story') both describe owner Paul Kelly purchasing the company from Blue Dot in 2004 and growing it independently to ~$250M revenue by 2022, including making its own tuck-in acquisitions. No evidence of PE or corporate parent ownership found, despite heavy PE consolidation activity elsewhere in the AZ HVAC/plumbing market.

No web presence could be found for a 'Simco Electric Inc.' electrical contractor in Phoenix, AZ specifically. Search results only surfaced same-named but clearly unrelated businesses (Simco Electric LLC in Duluth, MN; Simco Electric Inc in Salem, UT) and an unrelated calibration-lab company, SIMCO Electronics, which has a Scottsdale/Phoenix location but is a different industry (equipment calibration, not electrical contracting).

K2 Electric 'The K2 Story' about page plus IECI and Construction Today profiles: founded by Dean and Marna Kredit in 2003, now led by their son Jared Kredit as President/CEO, with brother Nick and wife Natalie also in leadership roles.
